data.long_meaning: Hirak is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Hira' meaning 'shining' and 'ak' meaning 'mountain'. The name Hirak carries the meaning “Shining Mountain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hirak usually hope their child will grow to embody shining mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
